enunciado: Use a global variable calls that counts how many times a function is invoked, and show that a local variable with the same name as a global one hides it inside its block.
objetivos: Tell global and local variables apart
pistas: A global is declared outside every function.
Inside a function, a local or a parameter with the same name hides the global.
Overusing globals makes code hard to follow: use them sparingly.
